        }

            out.close();
            return;

        for (int i = 1; i <= c; i++) {
            BigInteger term = mult(parity(c - i), ncr(c, i), pow(BigInteger.valueOf(i), n));
            answer = add(answer, term);
        }
        answer = mult(answer, BigInteger.valueOf(2), ncr(n, c));
        out.println(answer.mod(MOD));
        out.close();
    }

    static BigInteger[] factArr = new BigInteger[1];
    static BigInteger[] invFactArr = new BigInteger[1];
    static {
        factArr[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
        invFactArr[0] = BigInteger.ONE;
    }

    static BigInteger fact(int n) {
        if (n >= factArr.length) {
            int old = factArr.length;
            BigInteger[] newFact = new BigInteger[n + 1];
            BigInteger[] newInv = new BigInteger[n + 1];
            System.arraycopy(factArr, 0, newFact, 0, old);
            System.arraycopy(invFactArr, 0, newInv, 0, old);
            for (int i = old; i <= n; i++) {
                newFact[i] = newFact[i - 1].multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(i)).mod(MOD);
            }
            newInv[n] = newFact[n].modInverse(MOD);
            for (int i = n - 1; i >= old; i--) {
                newInv[i] = newInv[i + 1].multiply(BigInteger.valueOf(i + 1)).mod(MOD);
            }
            factArr = newFact;
            invFactArr = newInv;
        }
        return factArr[n];
    }

    static BigInteger invFact(int n) {
        fact(n);
        return invFactArr[n];
    }

    static BigInteger ncr(int n, int r) {
        if (r < 0 || r > n) return BigInteger.ZERO;
        return fact(n).multiply(invFact(r)).multiply(invFact(n - r)).mod(MOD);
    }

    static BigInteger parity(long k) {
        return (k & 1) == 0 ? BigInteger.ONE : MOD.subtract(BigInteger.ONE);
    }

    static BigInteger add(BigInteger a, BigInteger b) {
        return a.add(b).mod(MOD);
    }

    static BigInteger mult(BigInteger... x) {
        BigInteger r = BigInteger.ONE;
        for (BigInteger v : x) r = r.multiply(v).mod(MOD);
        return r;
    }

    static BigInteger pow(BigInteger x, int e) {
        if (e < 0) {
            x = x.modInverse(MOD);
            e = -e;
        }
        return x.modPow(BigInteger.valueOf(e), MOD);
    }
}
